sampling_method: Model-blind deterministic random.Random(20261118) stratified sampling over raw splits sorted by integer row id (PAWS-X) or (image_id, forward_pair_id, reverse_pair_id) (JGLUE JNLI), strictly excluding eval_gauntlet.json and eval_holdout.json pairs, all normalized single sentences across splits and within the fixture, cross-language PAWS-X source IDs, JNLI yjcaptions_id image prefixes, corrupt stubs, and JSICK/JRTE.
hygiene_and_exclusion_rules: Strictly model-blind syntactic filters only; authoritative dataset labels preserved verbatim.
Exclude all JSICK (CC BY-SA 4.0 / directional NLI semantics / akiFQC train overlap) and JRTE (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0).
Exclude all 20 PAWS-X source_ids present in eval_holdout.json from both paws_x_ja and paws_x_en, and disallow shared PAWS-X source_ids across ja and en.
Exclude all 40 JGLUE JNLI yjcaptions_id image prefixes present in eval_holdout.json (H01..H40) and enforce at most 1 pair per JNLI image_id across eval_holdout.json and eval_final_holdout.json.
Require is_same_language_pair(s1, s2) and target-language script match (contains_japanese True for ja, False for en).
Require len(normalize_sentence(s)) >= 5 and non-placeholder text (rejecting 'NS' stubs).
Require normalize_sentence(s1) != normalize_sentence(s2) (and case-insensitive inequality for en).
Enforce global normalized single-sentence uniqueness across eval_gauntlet.json, eval_holdout.json, and all pairs selected into eval_final_holdout.json.

JNLI bidir_entail cap note: jglue_jnli_test_v1.3.jsonl contains 57 two-row bidirectional entailment+entailment pairs (plus 1 degenerate 4-row s1==s2 group, image_id=378111); 20 are consumed by eval_holdout.json (H01..H20) and 8 fail normalize_sentence(s1) != normalize_sentence(s2) (7 exact identical strings + 1 NFKC-identical full-width/half-width numeral pair image_id=485984), leaving 29 eligible bidir_entail pairs. Neutral pairs are set to 9 (with 10 oneway_entail and 10 contradict) so JGLUE JNLI remains 50/50 balanced (29 ENTAIL / 29 NO_ENTAIL, 58 total) and the full benchmark is 50/50 balanced (89 ENTAIL / 89 NO_ENTAIL, 178 total).

paws_x_ja.ja_paws_swap: PAWS-X ja/test label == 0 (non-paraphrase / adversarial swap) -> NO_ENTAIL

paws_x_en.en_paws_swap: PAWS-X en/test label == 0 (non-paraphrase / adversarial swap) -> NO_ENTAIL

jglue_jnli.ja_jnli_bidir_entail: Both (s1 -> s2) and (s2 -> s1) labeled entailment -> ENTAIL
jglue_jnli.ja_jnli_oneway: One direction labeled entailment and reverse labeled neutral (oriented premise -> hypothesis in entailment direction) -> NO_ENTAIL
